title: Workflow for Generating Intelligent Textbooks
description: Interactive infographic MicroSim of the workflow used in intelligent book creation
subject: Mathematics
author: Dan McCreary
learningObjectives: Identify the two canvas regions of the standard MicroSim template: a drawing area of fixed drawHeight and a control strip of controlHeight below it
Explain why updateCanvasSize() must run first in setup() so the canvas matches the parent container width
Trace how moving the radius slider changes the circle diameter drawn at the center of the drawing region
Design a new MicroSim by adapting the template's setup(), draw(), and windowResized() functions to a different parameter
Predict how windowResized() rescales the canvas and slider when the browser window width changes
